news.title: Iraq's October Oil Exports Top 3.4 Million Bpd, Nearing Pre-War Levels
news.summary: Iraq's oil exports have averaged more than 3.4 million barrels per day so far in October, Oil Minister Bassem Mohammed Khudair told the state news agency INA on Monday. That puts them close to the 3.3-3.5 million bpd Iraq shipped before the war with Iran choked traffic through the Strait of Hormuz. The October figure is a jump of about 750,000 bpd from September, when exports averaged 2.65 million bpd according to the oil ministry. Of that, 250,000 bpd moved through the Iraq-Turkey pipeline to Ceyhan. Khudair said Iraq is now exporting through…

analysis_history.summary: Iraq's October oil exports rose by roughly 750,000 bpd to over 3.4 million bpd, nearing pre-war levels.
analysis_history.rationale: A substantial rebound and increase in Iraqi crude exports adds supply to the global market, placing downward pressure on oil prices.

analysis.summary: Iraq's crude oil exports climbed by 750,000 bpd month-over-month to surpass 3.4 million bpd in October.
analysis.rationale: A substantial rebound in physical crude oil exports from a major OPEC producer adds supply to the market, exerting downward pressure on prices despite concurrent modest benchmark price gains.

Lavrov traveled to the Iranian capital directly from Manama, Bahrain, where he had attended a meeting with Gulf Cooperation Council officials. Gulf states have urged Moscow to use its influence to press Tehran to halt attacks on its neighbors. Lavrov also met with Iran's security chief, Mohsen Rezaei,…

Weekly shipments fell 390,000 bpd to 3.13 million bpd, the lowest since March. Just 31 tankers loaded 21.91 million barrels, compared with 34 vessels carrying 24.63 million barrels the previous week.
